title: Kali Envelope Standard v1.0
description: Canonical envelope format required by BaseLayerOS deterministic substrate.

id.description: Stable identifier for the envelope. Usually a hash or UUID.

source.description: AI system, agent, or governance engine that produced this envelope.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the envelope was produced.

payload.description: Structured JSON payload. Keys must be deterministic and meaningful.
